subject: literacy
concept: Identifying common logical fallacies (straw man, false dilemma, ad hominem, slippery slope)
source_inspiration: original content, connecting to the Wisdom Pillar's critical-thinking work — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student sorts argument examples into their matching fallacy category
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a described flawed argument to the specific fallacy it demonstrates
exercise.abstract: Student identifies the logical fallacy present in a given argument and explains why it's flawed

misconception_flags: identifies that an argument is flawed but cannot name the specific type of fallacy involved

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
